Title: CME entry appears at the top of History
Steps: Open form; enter all required fields; submit form
Expected Result: New entry appears first in History without reload

Title: Credits validation blocks submission
Steps: Fill all required fields except credits; submit form
Expected Result: Submission is blocked and validation appears

Title: Reminder banner for missing documentation
Precondition: Entry requires documentation but lacks metadata
Steps: Load dashboard; observe reminder; open linked activity
Expected Result: Reminder appears and persists until metadata is attached

Title: Reviewer status update saves note
Steps: Choose Needs Correction; enter reviewer note; save update
Expected Result: Reviewer confirmation appears and note is visible in history

Title: Upload simulator stores metadata
Steps: Choose file with upload simulator; save metadata
Expected Result: Metadata filename and upload timestamp appear in the upload panel

Title: Key dates panel shows due windows
Steps: Open dashboard; inspect key dates panel
Expected Result: Milestone labels dates and due states are visible

Title: Release Room shows QA metrics
Steps: Open release room; inspect summary cards and evidence cards
Expected Result: Coverage tests open defects and evidence links are visible

Title: Release Summary shows recommendation
Steps: Open release summary; inspect recommendation and memo
Expected Result: Recommendation blockers rationale and signoff date are visible

Title: Defect board shows triage fields
Steps: Open release room; inspect defect board rows
Expected Result: Each defect row shows severity owner status and next step

Title: Submitted activity persists after reload
Steps: Submit CME entry; reload page; inspect history
Expected Result: Submitted activity remains in history after reload

Title: Required field validation reports all missing fields
Steps: Submit empty form; inspect validation list
Expected Result: Validation banner and field-level messages appear

Title: Credit field cannot be omitted
Steps: Leave credits blank; submit form
Expected Result: Form remains unsaved and credits error is visible

Title: History order places newest submission first
Steps: Submit new entry; inspect first history item
Expected Result: Newest submitted title is first in History

Title: Reviewer note appears in latest detail text
Steps: Save reviewer note; inspect visible details
Expected Result: Latest reviewer note appears without page reload

Title: Metadata reminder count is visible
Steps: Load dashboard; inspect reminders card
Expected Result: Reminder count matches missing metadata and correction states

Title: UAT packet link opens from release evidence
Steps: Open release room; select UAT packet PDF link
Expected Result: Published PDF asset is linked from the release page

Title: Static build creates all entrypoint HTML files
Steps: Run production build; inspect dist folder
Expected Result: Dashboard release room and release summary HTML files are generated

Title: Successful CME submission queues confirmation
Precondition: Dashboard is loaded with seeded activities
Steps: Enter required activity fields; save entry
Expected Result: Confirmation banner appears and history is updated

Title: Upload metadata clears selected activity gap
Steps: Attach test certificate file; inspect upload panel
Expected Result: Stored metadata message and filename are visible

Title: Reminder action selects related activity
Steps: Click Upload metadata from reminder
Expected Result: Upload simulator targets the reminder activity

Title: Next due summary displays date and days remaining
Precondition: Seed key dates include future or overdue milestone
Steps: Open dashboard; inspect Next due card
Expected Result: Next due label formatted date and due delta appear

Title: Release evidence links include automation and UAT
Steps: Open release room; inspect evidence cards
Expected Result: Playwright smoke report and UAT results links are present

Title: Signoff memo distinguishes tested and untested scope
Steps: Open release summary; inspect memo details
Expected Result: Scope tested not tested residual risk and rationale are visible

Title: Open blockers keep owner and next step visible
Precondition: Release Room defect board is loaded
Steps: Inspect CR-401 CR-312 and CR-287 rows
Expected Result: Each blocker keeps owner status and next step visible

Title: LocalStorage reload preserves reviewer updates
Precondition: Reviewer update can be saved locally
Steps: Save reviewer note; reload page; inspect history
Expected Result: Reviewer note remains visible after reload
